close_reason: Verified in code — implementation matches decision exactly.
description: In handle_mdn_send (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs lines 191-198), a null forEmailId is caught at the handler level and placed in notSent as an invalidProperties SetError with a description quoting the spec (draft §2: 'forEmailId MUST NOT be null for MDN/send'). This is a deliberate spec-conformance decision: the spec §2 says the property MUST NOT be null for MDN/send, making it an invalid input, not a lookup failure. Using invalidProperties rather than notFound correctly distinguishes 'the client sent a prohibited value' from 'the email could not be found in the store'. The MemoryBackend send_mdns also has a fallback notFound check for None forEmailId (common/mod.rs line 2286-2293), which is dead code given the handler pre-check but is kept as a safety net for direct backend callers who bypass the handler.
title: DECISION: null forEmailId caught at handler level (invalidProperties), not backend (notFound)
